subject: Request: brief policy variance for debugging - Bluecrest integration
messages:
From: Jake Muller <jake.muller@bluecrest.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Bluecrest Infra <infra@bluecrest.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 14:07:00 -0500
Subject: Unexpected inference failures — request to hold logs

Hi Priya,

We started seeing intermittent incorrect predictions from the "customer-risk" model during a Canary rollout this morning (12/12). We need Redwood's help to capture more of the raw request/response context and a bit more of the KV cache state for the tenant "bluecrest-prod" while we triage.

Specifically we are requesting: a short, timeboxed deviation from the standard 7-day ephemeral retention so your team can preserve the detailed token-level traces + debug metadata for 5 business days (starting now). These traces will contain hashed user identifiers and model inputs that may include financial metadata — no free text PII on our side but we want to be transparent.

Can you advise the fastest path to (1) authorize a short retention carveout for this tenant, (2) snapshot the relevant logs and make them available to our engineers with restricted access, and (3) confirm deletion after the window? We can provide a minimal list of request IDs if that helps.

Attached: audit_snapshot_request.pdf (one-page request)

Thanks,
Jake
Head of Platform — Bluecrest Analytics

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 14:35:00 -05:00
Subject: Fwd: Unexpected inference failures — request to hold logs

Folks — forwarding Bluecrest's request. They need a brief deviation to preserve token-level traces for "bluecrest-prod" for debugging. They ask for a 5-business-day window starting now.

Key constraints I'd like us to consider: minimal scope (tenant + specific request IDs), short duration, encryption-at-rest with KMS access logs, and documented deletion confirmation.

Attached: bluecrest_debug_manifest.csv

Can we triage risk and sign off or propose a tighter window? Rishi, any objections from security? Laura, any legal/contractful barriers here? David, can eng produce a snapshot and an isolated link with RBAC?

Thanks — Priya
Sr. Sales Ops (Enterprise) — Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Unexpected inference failures — request to hold logs

Priya — thanks for flagging. Quick security assessment: we can permit a temporary retention variance provided we hard-scope the data, limit the window, and record the change in our audit log. Requirements:

- Scope: only token traces + request/response payloads for tenant "bluecrest-prod" and the specific request IDs they supply. No cross-tenant data.
- Duration: prefer 72 hours (3 calendar days) instead of 5 business days; shorter window reduces exposure.
- Controls: snapshot must be written to a customer-scoped, encrypted GCS bucket or Redwood secure bucket with RBAC limited to named Bluecrest infra contacts + named Redwood engineers. KMS key usage must be logged.
- Documentation: sign-off recorded in SUP-2184 and a signed attestation from Bluecrest acknowledging sensitive fields.

If Bluecrest insists on 5 business days, we should require an escalation approval from Legal + VP Ops. Also recommend redaction of any free-text fields flagged as PII before transfer.

I can approve a 72-hour window pending confirmation of exact request IDs and RBAC list.

-rishi
Head of Security — Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Unexpected inference failures — request to hold logs

On Mon, Dec 14, 2026 at 09:12 AM PST, Rishi Malhotra wrote:
> Priya — thanks for flagging. Quick security assessment: we can permit a temporary retention variance provided we hard-scope the data, limit the window, and record the change in our audit log.

Agree with Rishi. Legal is comfortable approving a limited carveout with conditions:

1) Approve 72-hour preservation window starting 2026-12-14T17:00:00Z (end 2026-12-17T17:00:00Z).
2) Scope must be limited to the request IDs Bluecrest supplies; no broader retention.
3) Bluecrest must sign the attestation in SUP-2184 acknowledging that they may receive hashed identifiers and that they will not attempt re-identification.
4) An internal deletion confirmation must be posted in the ticket with object names and checksums.

David — please proceed to snapshot the listed data into the secure folder below, set object-level ACLs to the listed emails (jake.muller@bluecrest.ai, infra@bluecrest.ai) + david_kim@redwood.ai, and tag the snapshot with the SUP-2184 reference. After 72 hours, run the deletion playbook and publish the confirmation.

I will mark this as approved in SUP-2184 and add the legal attestation template.

-Laura
VP, Product Ops — Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jake Muller <jake.muller@bluecrest.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Unexpected inference failures — request to hold logs

On Mon, Dec 14, 2026 at 11:04 AM EST, Laura Bennett wrote:
> David — please proceed to snapshot the listed data into the secure folder below...

Snapshot completed and objects uploaded:
- bluecrest_prod_snapshot_20261214.tar.gz (sha256: b1946ac...)
- request_traces_20261214.ndjson.gz
Stored at: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_example_snapshot (access limited to Bluecrest infra, david_kim@redwood.ai)
SUP ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-2184 (I added the object names and checksums).

Retention window set: 2026-12-14T17:00:00Z -> 2026-12-17T17:00:00Z. Deletion automation scheduled; I will post the deletion confirmation here when run.

Jake — please confirm that Bluecrest infra can access the folder and that these files contain the request IDs you expected. If you need additional IDs, send them to me and we'll append only those objects.

Thanks — David
Senior SRE — Redwood Inference
